# Public DE artwork sample for issue #519

The fixture retains two programme records from the anonymous schema-5 DE artwork feed and the display names of their channels. The source GZIP was 6,921,838 bytes with SHA-256 `22a07509bb76e7ee79904247c05cf57b45f2030c07a37304c43507a7bf05d75f`. Programme timestamps and fields are preserved.

- `s1.KIKA.de` aired Die Schlümpfe on 26 November 2026 from 16:25–17:00 UTC (17:25–18:00 Europe/Berlin). The row has a description, subtitle and six cast credits. It has no image or icon reference and no TMDB work ID.
- `s1.13th.Street.Universal.de` aired Law & Order: Special Victims Unit on the same date from 18:25–19:15 UTC. The row has work ID `tv/2734`, a poster and a backdrop.
